BEZ-235 + GELDANAMYCIN may show a high joint score across lines with active PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling, but PIK3CA mutation or amplification is not established as the determinant. This is supported by a single indirect observation, a strong joint score in DLD1 (synergy 3.8, inhibition 67, joint 0.52). Test it in PIK3CA-mutant lines (HCT116, T-47D, RKO) against PIK3CA-wild-type lines (SW-620, SW837, PA1) to see whether PIK3CA status predicts response. | Why this experiment: T-47D is a PIK3CA-mutant line predicted as a H1 responder, so it tests whether PIK3CA status predicts response to BEZ-235 + geldanamycin. | Predicted responders: T-47D, OCUBM, HCT116, RKO, SK-OV-3, NCI-H460, CAOV3, UWB1289

BEZ-235 + GELDANAMYCIN may be effective in BRAF V600E melanoma lines (A375, A2058, UACC62, HT144), where mutant BRAF is an HSP90 client. PTEN loss in A2058 and UACC62 could add PI3K dependence. This is untested and rests on thin evidence. ES2 should be treated as an ovarian BRAF V600E line, not melanoma. | Why this experiment: A375 is a BRAF V600E melanoma line with intact PTEN, so it tests BRAF-as-HSP90-client dependence (PMID:19850405) without PTEN loss. | Predicted responders: A2058, UACC62, A375, HT144, ES2

BEZ-235 + GELDANAMYCIN may show a high joint score in KRAS-mutant lines (A427, NCIH2122, NCI-H460, SW-620, SW837, HCT116), if PI3K/mTOR inhibition triggers pro-survival feedback. This is an extrapolation, because the cited work showed that autophagy can limit dactolisib efficacy in KRAS-mutant A549 cells and combined it with an autophagy inhibitor, not an HSP90 inhibitor. HSP90 inhibition as a substitute for autophagy blockade is untested. | Why this experiment: A427 is a KRAS-mutant lung line, so it tests whether HSP90 inhibition can stand in for the autophagy blockade used with dactolisib in PMID:37677845.

BEZ-235 + MK-8669 is likely to give low or non-additive synergy, because both drugs inhibit mTOR. Complete mTORC1 blockade by one agent may leave little room for gain from the other. Treat this as a low-priority pair rather than a certain null. A modest benefit is still possible in lines with feedback AKT activation, which a rapalog could worsen while BEZ-235 suppresses it. | Why this experiment: MDAMB436 has the most negative prediction for BEZ-235 + MK-8669 and high uncertainty, so a single run tests the same-target non-additivity hypothesis (PMID:20945947).
The BEZ-235 + dinaciclib pair has no data and a highly uncertain, very negative prediction, so one run in MDAMB436 checks the model and explores the CDK inhibitor class.

This goes against the model's negative prediction (pred_mean about -0.1, std 1.2), which is weakly informative. It is also a revision of H5. | Why this experiment: HCT116 is a PIK3CA-mutant line, so it tests whether the BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB result in MDAMB436 (joint 0.50) extends to PIK3CA-mutant lines, against a flat model prediction.

The p53-synthetic-lethality support is for adavosertib alone, and combined benefit from BEZ-235 is general pharmacology. | Why this experiment: ES2 (TP53 S241F) tests AZD1775 + BEZ-235 in a TP53-mutant line that should depend on the G2/M checkpoint (PMID:38519399). | Predicted responders: MDAMB436, ES2, OV90, VCAP, A2058, UACC62

BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE is an untested, low-confidence candidate in melanoma lines (A2058, A375, UACC62), supported only by general pharmacology on replication stress and PI3K/AKT-mediated DNA damage tolerance. The pair is not supported by any provided source and the PTEN or CDKN2A rationale is speculative. | Why this experiment: A2058 (PTEN loss) tests whether PI3K/mTOR blockade sensitizes cells to gemcitabine-induced replication stress; this is low-confidence, with only indirect support from PMID:39992316. | Predicted responders: A2058, UACC62, A375

BEZ-235 + MK-2206 is predicted to have low or modest joint scores in A2058, because both drugs act on the same PI3K/AKT axis, though vertical blockade in a PTEN-null line could still be effective. The prediction is slightly negative (-0.10, std 0.92). | Why this experiment: A2058 is PTEN-null, so this tests whether vertical PI3K/mTOR plus AKT blockade beats additivity or is merely redundant. | Predicted responders: A2058
BEZ-235 + CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE in A2058 has no hypothesis and an alkylator partner is an untested drug class, so this is an explore pick.

BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE will show a high joint score in LNCAP, the prostate line with PTEN loss, because PI3K/mTOR blockade should remove AKT-mediated tolerance of gemcitabine-induced replication stress. | Why this experiment: Tests whether the BEZ-235 + gemcitabine effect from A2058 carries over to PTEN-null LNCAP, where the model prediction is tightest (0.41, std 0.47). | Predicted responders: LNCAP

BEZ-235 + DEXAMETHASONE has no mechanistic link to the DNA-damage argument and should be treated separately. | Why this experiment: Doxorubicin has the top model score among untested BEZ-235 pairs in A2058 and checks whether the gemcitabine result extends to other DNA-damaging agents.

BEZ-235 + CARBOPLATIN and BEZ-235 + OXALIPLATIN will score poorly (pred_mean about -0.32 to -0.40, std about 1.4). They should be deprioritized in A2058, SK-OV-3, OVCAR3 and OCUBM until a model-independent signal appears. | Why this experiment: A2058 is the best BEZ-235 responder, so one platinum pair (carboplatin) there checks whether the pessimistic prediction (-0.32, std 1.41) holds and whether platinum agents can be deprioritized.

DINACICLIB + OXALIPLATIN, CARBOPLATIN + DINACICLIB and DINACICLIB + ZOLINZA are predicted to score poorly in T-47D, MDAMB436 and SK-OV-3, but the predictions are very uncertain (std about 1.7). The only observed dinaciclib-cytotoxic pair, CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE + DINACICLIB in MDAMB436, scored -3.74, which gives limited support for deprioritizing cytotoxic partners. | Why this experiment: Carboplatin + dinaciclib in T-47D checks the poor, very uncertain prediction (std 1.71), which rests on one cyclophosphamide result; this tests whether cytotoxic partners for dinaciclib can be dropped.

BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE is positive in A2058 (0.89), T-47D (0.82), NCIH2122 (0.35) and LNCAP (0.33), so activity looks broad across genotypes. The predictions for OCUBM, MSTO, A375 and VCAP rest only on a model and should be tested, with no assumption that the effect extends to them. | Why this experiment: BEZ-235 + gemcitabine in OCUBM has a tight prediction (std 0.35) and extends the strongest pair (A2058 0.89, T-47D 0.82) to an untested PIK3CA-mutant breast line.

BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE is the strongest pair so far: A2058 (joint 0.89), T-47D (0.82), NCIH2122 (0.35) and LNCAP (0.33) are all positive. Response does not track PTEN loss alone, because T-47D is PTEN-intact and PIK3CA-mutant, and NCIH2122 is a KRAS-mutant lung line. Test UACC62 and A375 to separate PI3K pathway dependence from a general replication-stress effect. | Why this experiment: A375 is PTEN-intact with CDKN2A loss, so it separates PI3K-pathway dependence from a general replication-stress effect for BEZ-235 + gemcitabine. | Predicted responders: A2058, UACC62, A375

Test PTEN-intact, PIK3CA-wild-type lines such as SKMES1 and SW837. | Why this experiment: MSTO is a lung line that tests whether the gemcitabine pair is genotype-agnostic, as seen in NCIH2122 (0.35), at a tight prediction (std 0.38).

BEZ-235 + MK-2206 was already strong in T-47D (joint 0.87). UWB1289 (PIK3CA amplified, NF1 loss) is untested for this pair and is a reasonable test of whether activity extends to other PI3K-activated lines, though BEZ-235 already suppresses AKT. | Why this experiment: UWB1289 (PIK3CA amplified, NF1 loss) tests whether BEZ-235 + MK-2206 extends beyond T-47D (0.87) and SK-OV-3 (0.52), with the tightest prediction for this pair (std 0.34). | Predicted responders: UWB1289

Whether it extends to PIK3CA-mutant breast lines T-47D and OCUBM is untested, and the HDAC feedback rationale is general pharmacology. | Why this experiment: T-47D tests whether the BEZ-235 + ZOLINZA activity seen in A2058 (0.48) extends to a PIK3CA-mutant breast line (pred 0.49, std 0.38). | Predicted responders: T-47D, OCUBM

BEZ-235 + PD325901 gave high synergy in A2058 (13.2) but only a modest joint score (0.31). Activity in T-47D and OCUBM is an untested prediction, and expect modest effects because neither line carries MAPK-activating mutations in the panel. | Why this experiment: BEZ-235 + PD325901 in T-47D tests whether MEK blockade counters compensatory ERK activation in a line without MAPK mutations, contrasting with A2058 (synergy 13.2, joint 0.31). | Predicted responders: T-47D, OCUBM

AZD1775 + BEZ-235 is predicted to be only modestly active across the shortlist lines (pred_mean 0.07-0.25, std about 0.65-0.73), with the largest predicted effect in T-47D (0.25) and OCUBM (0.22). It should rank below the BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE, MK-2206 and ZOLINZA pairs. | Why this experiment: AZD1775 + BEZ-235 in T-47D is the top predicted line for this pair and serves as a high-uncertainty contrast (std 0.73) for ranking it below the stronger BEZ-235 partners.
BEZ-235 + metformin is an untested drug class with a very uncertain prediction (-0.41, std 1.26), so running it is informative whichever way it comes out.

BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB should have a high joint score in A2058, where the shortlist model gives its best BEZ-235 prediction (pred_mean 0.18, std 0.51). T-47D (joint 0.34) and MDAMB436 (0.31) have already scored positive for this pair. A2058 is untested for it. | Why this experiment: BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB is untested in PTEN-null A2058 but was positive in T-47D and MDAMB436, and it has the best model prediction of any BEZ-235 pair (0.18, std 0.51), so it extends H26 and H7. | Predicted responders: A2058

BEZ-235 + ETOPOSIDE is untested. The model predicts 0.16 in T-47D with std 0.50. BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE paired strongly in T-47D (joint 0.72), but nothing observed tests etoposide directly. Any similarity argument is general pharmacology, and PMID:39992316 (cisplatin nanoparticles) is only indirect. | Why this experiment: BEZ-235 + etoposide in T-47D has a modestly positive prediction (0.16, std 0.50) and tests whether the gemcitabine-type DNA-damage sensitization generalizes to a topoisomerase II inhibitor.

AZD1775 + GEMCITABINE in A2058 is predicted to score poorly (pred_mean -1.21, std 1.69).
